INSERT INTO oauth_accounts (
            user_id,
            provider,
            provider_user_id,
            email,
            email_verified,
            access_token,
            refresh_token,
            token_type
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            'MICROSOFT'::oauth_provider,
            $2,
            $3,
            true,
            $4,
            $5,
            'Bearer'
         )
